blocks.text: LUCENA CITY — Calamba City in Laguna recorded a heat index of 43°C on Tuesday, placing the city under the “danger” category and prompting local authorities to warn residents against prolonged exposure to extreme heat. The City Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office (CDRRMO) said in an advisory that the heat index reached 43°C at 1 p.m., up from 40°C at 11:30 a.m. and 38°C at 10:20 a.m. Calamba City recorded a heat index of 40°C on Oct. 26, 38°C on Oct. 25 and 24, and 37°C on Oct. 23.
